newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks edge up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks edge up in light trade.

text.p: The Estonian stock market edged up in light trade on Monday with Hansapank leading the way.
Official list trade reached 39 million kroons while the index rose by a small 1.19 percent to 161.16.
Market leader Hansapank was again the most traded stock on a turnover of 19.7 million kroons and it closed higher at 165 kroons against 161 kroons on Friday.
Tallinna Pank turned over 7.3 million kroons, but closed lower at 55.85 kroons against 56.20 and Forekspank closed at 123.45 kroons against 118.20 kroons turning over 5.8 million.

The over-the-counter market was led by department store Tallinna Kaubamaja which had 2.6 million volume but closed 1.15 kroons lower at 76.20 kroons. The total volume of the free market was 5 million kroons.
